review.shorterRouteAssessment: No scheme analytification or general simultaneous approximation is needed. The existing original manifold/valuation separation proof applies after the actual local chart inputs now proved for the cover. Global compactness requires its own finite-coordinate fiber-cover argument and connectedness its own clopen obstruction; neither follows just from the atlas and neither is being assumed here.

review.discharged: The actual place set of the literal original complex torsion cover carries a constructed native complex analytic charted-space/manifold structure and is Hausdorff. Its native extended charts have genuine residue-value readings with exact normalized place orders. Actual inverse chart families are continuous and have open images. The proof uses the constructed compatible uniformizer charts and an actual function separating distinct rank-one valuation rings; no topology, atlas, separation or evaluation-order premise remains in these consumers.
